prompt: Use the codex-invoke skill to create a FastAPI endpoint at /api/auth/login that accepts email and password, validates them against the users table in Supabase, and returns a JWT token on success. Use bcrypt for password verification.

assertions.name: input_validation
assertions.description: Endpoint validates email and password inputs with Pydantic models

assertions.name: jwt_returned
assertions.description: Returns JWT token on successful authentication

assertions.name: error_handling
assertions.description: Returns proper error responses for failed auth
